## Purpose and evidence standard

This note covers vocational education and apprenticeship products in the
current build: NCVER Total VET Activity (`TVA`) and DEWR Apprentice and
Trainee (`A&T`).

| Evidence label | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Official | Backed by an official public source linked here. |
| Local generator | Observed in current `fplida` code, tests, or generated smoke data. |
| Unresolved | No source was found in this pass. Do not use as calibration truth. |

## Source documents

| Source | Use |
|---|---|
| `inst/plida_metadata/*.csv` | DIL product and variable inventory. |
| `R/generate_tva.R`, `src/rust/src/tva.rs`, `inst/foundations/tva.toml`, `tests/testthat/test-generate_tva.R` | TVA generated table schemas and tested domains. |
| `R/generate_apprentice.R`, `src/rust/src/apprentice.rs`, `tests/testthat/test-generate_batch5.R` | Apprentice generated schema and tested value domains. |
| [NCVER Total VET students and courses](https://www.ncver.edu.au/research-and-statistics/collections/students-and-courses-collection/total-vet-students-and-courses) | Official TVA source context: National VET Provider Collection and VET in Schools under AVETMISS. |
| [NCVER AVETMISS overview](https://www.ncver.edu.au/rto-hub/what-is-avetmiss) | Official source for AVETMISS data-element definitions and rules. |
| [AVETMISS data element definitions](https://www.ncver.edu.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0022/62383/AVETMISS-Data-element-definitions-2_3-Nov-2022.pdf) | Official AVETMISS data-element source for VET variable definitions, formats, and code-list checks. |
| [DEWR Australian Apprenticeships](https://www.dewr.gov.au/australian-apprenticeships) | Official apprenticeship program context. |

## Source-backed coverage decisions

| Product area | What the research source supports | What is still not found |
|---|---|---|
| TVA | NCVER collection pages and AVETMISS data-element definitions are the official anchors for TVA element definitions and many VET code-list checks. | The guide still needs exact AVETMISS element citations attached to each generated TVA category before labels are promoted. |
| Apprentice and trainee | DEWR pages support program context, and local metadata gives same-dataset A&T concept matches for compact generated fields. | I did not find a public A&T variable-level codebook in this pass for generated status weights, qualification-level weights, or all compact category labels. |

## Product inventory

| Dataset | Metadata products | Current fplida coverage |
|---|---:|---|
| `TVA` | 88+ | Current generator writes training activity and completions products by year plus NCVER spine. |
| `A&T` | 1+ | Current generator writes one compact apprentice/trainee product plus DEWR spine. |

## Variable-level schema register

Every generated variable observed in this pass for this guide is listed in
[`schema-registers/schema-register-vet-apprentice.csv`](schema-registers/schema-register-vet-apprentice.csv).
The register records R type, sampled generated missingness, sampled generated
domains/distributions, and direct PLIDA metadata matches. Treat those sampled
domains/distributions as implementation evidence only, not as official source
data.

A rendered variable evidence appendix for this guide is available at [`variable-evidence-appendices/vet-apprentice-variable-evidence.qmd`](variable-evidence-appendices/vet-apprentice-variable-evidence.qmd). It contains one row per generated variable with observed generated values or distributions, local metadata/crosswalk status, and unresolved-source caveats.

A stricter source-audited variable-code evidence register is available at
[`vet-apprentice-variable-code-evidence.csv`](vet-apprentice-variable-code-evidence.csv),
with a rendered companion note at
[`vet-apprentice-variable-code-evidence.qmd`](vet-apprentice-variable-code-evidence.qmd).
Use that register to distinguish AVETMISS public source support, local
PLIDA/generator evidence, apprentice-codebook-not-found rows, and generated
domains that need format tightening.

| Dataset | Generated variable rows | Direct PLIDA metadata matches | No direct PLIDA name match |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `A&T` | 14 | 8 | 6 |
| `TVA` | 74 | 74 | 0 |

Rows without a direct PLIDA match need a generated-name to DIL-name crosswalk
before they are treated as source variables. For VET, the AVETMISS material is
the stronger source for TVA element definitions; apprentice/trainee compact
fields still need direct code-list evidence.

## TVA generated schema and domains

NCVER and AVETMISS sources should be used for final code labels. The local
tests provide strong implementation contracts for current code domains.

### Training activity

| Variable group | Variables | Expected values or distribution | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Person/year keys | `SYNTHETIC_AEUID`, `TVA_ROW_ID`, `COLLECTION_YR` | Collection year must match the output year key. | Local tests |
| Demographics | `AGE`, `YEAR_OF_BIRTH`, `MONTH_OF_BIRTH`, `GENDER_ID` | `MONTH_OF_BIRTH` 1 to 12; `GENDER_ID` in 1,2; age non-negative. | Local tests |
| Prior education and school status | `HIGHEST_SCHL_LVL_ST`, `HIGHEST_ED_LVL_ST`, `PRIOR_ED_ACHIEVE_FG`, `AT_SCHOOL_FG` | Flag variables tested as `Y`/`N`; level labels unresolved. | Local tests; official AVETMISS labels unresolved |
| Labour and occupation | `LABOUR_FORCE_STATUS_ID`, `ANZSCO_ID` | Coded values generated locally; official labels unresolved in this pass. | Local generator |
| Program | `PROGRAM_ID`, `PROGRAM_FOE_ID`, `PROGRAM_LOE_ID`, `PROGRAM_RECOGNITION_ID`, `PROGRAM_TRAINING_PACKAGE_ID`, `PROGRAM_TYPE_OF_TRAINING_ID`, `PROGRAM_NOMINAL_HOURS`, `PROGRAM_VET_FG` | `PROGRAM_FOE_ID` tested in `03` to `12` selected ASCED fields; `PROGRAM_LOE_ID` tested in 511, 514, 521, 524, 611, 613; VET flag `Y`/`N`. | Local tests |
| Subject | `SUBJECT_ID`, `SUBJECT_FOE_ID`, `SUBJECT_NOMINAL_HOURS`, `SUBJECT_VET_FG`, `SUBJECT_FG` | Subject nominal hours positive; subject flags `Y`/`N`. | Local tests |
| Participation flags | `APPRENTICESHIP_FG`, `VET_IN_SCHOOLS_FG`, `STUDENT_COMMENCING_FG` | Tested domain `Y`, `N`. | Local tests |
| Timing/outcome | `STUDY_REASON_ID`, `ACTIVITY_START_DATE`, `ACTIVITY_END_DATE`, `DELIVERY_MODE_ID`, `NATIONAL_FUNDING_SOURCE_ID`, `NATIONAL_OUTCOME_ID` | End date must not precede start date; delivery mode tested in 10,20,30,40,90; funding in 11,20,30,31,80,99; outcome in 20,30,40,51,60,70,81,90. | Local tests |
| Geography/provider | `CLIENT_POSTCODE_DERIVED`, `CLIENT_STATE_RESIDENCE_DERIVED`, `CLIENT_REMOTENESS_ID_DERIVED`, `CLIENT_SEIFA_IRSD_QUINT_DRVD`, `RTO_ID`, `TRAIN_ORG_TYPE_ID`, `HEAD_OFFICE_STATE`, `HEAD_OFFICE_POSTCODE`, `STATE_OF_FUNDING_GF` | Remoteness tested 0 to 4; SEIFA quintile 1 to 5; training organisation type in 21,31,61,91,95,97. | Local tests |

## Apprentice and trainee generated schema and domains

The current apprentice generator is a compact synthetic product rather than a
full AVETMISS apprentice/trainee collection. `generated-variable-crosswalk.csv`
now maps the compact no-direct-match A&T fields to same-dataset Apprentice and
Trainee metadata variables.

| Variable | Type | Expected values or distribution | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SYNTHETIC_AEUID` | Character ID | DEWR agency person key. | Local generator |
| `STATUS` | Categorical | Tested/local domain `Completed`, `In Training`, `Cancelled`, `Expired`; Rust weights 0.40/0.25/0.25/0.10. | Local tests/Rust |
| `ANZSCO` | Code | Occupation code from spine, or `0000` if missing. | Local Rust; same-dataset A&T metadata crosswalk to `ANZSCOCODE` |
| `QUALIFICATION_LEVEL` | Integer/category | Tested/local domain 2,3,4,5; Rust comments map these to Cert II, Cert III, Cert IV, Diploma; weights 0.10/0.55/0.25/0.10. | Local tests/Rust; same-dataset A&T metadata crosswalk to `QUALLEVEL` |
| `START_DATE`, `END_DATE` | Date/integer date | Start generated from 2006 to 2023; end present for completed/cancelled records, missing for in-training/expired records in local logic. | Local Rust |
| `DAYS_IN_TRAINING` | Integer | Local range 365 to 1460 days. | Local Rust; same-dataset A&T metadata crosswalk to `DAYSINTRAINING` |
| `GENDER` | Categorical | Local domain `M`, `F`. | Local Rust |
| `DOB_Y`, `DOB_M` | Integer | Birth year from spine; month 1 to 12. | Local Rust |
| `INDIGENOUS_STATUS`, `SCHOOL_BASED` | Categorical | Local domain `Y`, `N`. | Local Rust; same-dataset A&T metadata crosswalks to `INDIGENOUSSTATUSCODE` and `SCHOOLBASEDAPPRENTICE` |
| `COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH`, `STATE_ASGS_2021` | Code | Country and state codes from spine. | Local generator; `COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH` has same-dataset A&T metadata crosswalk to `COUNTRYOFBIRTHCODE` |

## Research uses and limits

TVA is suitable for testing VET course/activity/completion workflows and
geographic/provider joins. The apprentice product is suitable for simple
apprenticeship-status examples, but not yet a full substitute for official
apprentice/trainee collections.

## Build implications

1. Use NCVER AVETMISS documentation to add code labels for TVA values before
   user-facing examples interpret them.
2. Keep TVA training activity and completions as separate tables; do not infer
   completions from activity outcome codes without a documented rule.
3. Expand A&T only after sourcing official apprentice/trainee variable and
   status definitions.
